svg.text: Measure metadata by how an agent fails with it. Rank by what depends on it.
THE PREMISE — coverage cannot tell these two apart, but an agent can:
gross_revenue → "...in USD before returns, refunds and tax." usable
so: stop counting descriptions. start measuring whether one can be acted on.
PRESENTATION — React + Vite SPA (one page, no router)
renders only validated structured fields. never raw model prose.
ORCHESTRATION — runner.run_probes() [one pass per probe, no agent loop]
Engine A is a documented HYPOTHESIS about behaviour, not evidence about real models.
Engine B is what turns the hypothesis into a measurement. Only B produces evidence.
DETERMINISTIC ZONE — code owns every verdict
RATE not count → thorough testing isn't punished
(1 + downstream) → blast radius from the graph
cert = 1.5 → a badge is a promise
abstained contributes ZERO. only the dangerous
PERSISTENCE — SQLite (zero setup, seeded + upserted on boot)
2. INSERT OR IGNORE → corrected probes never
3. a fact found in the asset NAME, not any
probabilistic — may be wrong, is measured
INV-1 no wrong answer may match its own marker
INV-2 ground truth never leaves the probes table
INV-3 GT = the omitted fact, not "metadata is empty"
verify: py backend\selfcheck.py · py backend\repaircheck.py · py backend\apicheck.py · py backend\measure.py · npm run build
CLOSING THE LOOP — the repair gate (detailed on sheet 3)
